tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0083, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0084 1. Lemma 3.11\group variation-formulas

If $\gamma _t$ is a time-dependent family of curves with fixed endpoints and $\partial _t g=h$, then \[ rac{d}{dt}L_t(\gamma _t) = rac12\int _{\gamma _t}h(S,S)\, ds-\int _{\gamma _t}\langle abla _S S,V angle \, ds, \] where $S$ is the unit tangent and $V$ is the variation vector field.

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0083, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0084 \sketch Differentiate the length integral, use $[U,V]=0$, and integrate by parts the term $\langle S, abla _S V angle $; the endpoint contribution vanishes because the endpoints are fixed.

□
